note: Eunhwa: Tactical Upgrade (slug eunhwa-tactical-upgrade, aka eunwhatu — variant of base eunhwa; never the bare base name, P0 disambiguation) — Elysion Fire SR Attacker, Burst II, 20s CD, 6-round SR (69.04% normal / 250% FC). FROM-SCRATCH kit-autonomy build 2026-07-27 (no prior override; baseline was bare weapon, simSupported:false). S2 AS FORMATION (unconditional passives, 'activates only when self survives' = unconditional, no death in v1): E1 Critical Rate ▲8.16% 'all allies from the same squad' encoded as plain allies — the sim fields exactly ONE deployed squad, so same-squad ≡ the whole team (anchor-innocent-maid / emma-tu precedent; distinct from noir's teamHas.slugs gate on NAMED lore-mates, which is a gate not a target set); E2 Charge Damage ▲41.81% all allies (chargeDamagePct, additive ppt in the charge bucket); E3 ATK ▲42.24% self (atkPct). S2 BONUS 'when applying LT Formation to self' (E1 Projectile Explosion Damage ▲5.11%, E2 True Damage ▲30.97%, all allies): LT Formation is applied by emma-tactical-upgrade (MG/Fire/B1), whose own AS-Formation bonus is the mirror interaction. Encoded behind teamHas.slugs:['emma-tactical-upgrade'] — an AUTO composition gate (presence ≡ formation applied: both formations are unconditional in-game passives), per the emma-tu override note's explicit recommendation ('prefer a teamHas.slugs auto-gate over the manual mode'). emma-tu IS simSupported, so a board team CAN field both sisters and the bonus is board-live (not a dead mode). projectileExplosionPct feeds only explosion-flavored hits and (projExplOnRlNormals default ON) RL NORMAL attacks — inert on ETU's SR normals, live on an RL teammate's normals. S1 CAMOUFLAGE SCARF: the two Camouflage lines (on Burst use; on Full Charge during Full Burst — 'prevents being targeted by single-target attacks for 5s, removed on a direct hit') are DEFENSIVE and UNMODELED — v1 has a single immortal boss and no targeting model, so target-prevention moves no damage. The third S1 line 'Activates only when in Camouflage status: Normal attacks deal true damage continuously; True Damage ▲42.24% continuously' splits in two: the True Damage ▲42.24% buff IS encoded (self trueDamagePct 42.24, windowed to the Camouflage uptime — see below); the 'normal attacks deal true damage continuously' FLAVOR CHANGE is UNMODELED+FLAGGED (see caveats) — the engine's only true-normal mechanism is weaponSwap.trueNormals, which is windowed and cannot coexist with her burst cannon swap (single swap slot), and the Camouflage window is expressed directly as buff windows rather than a named status (the selfStatus/requiresSelfStatus channel exists as of 2026-08-24; a selfStatus re-encode is a mechanical candidate). The 42.24 buff is modeled as a WINDOWED self buff that tracks the Camouflage uptime the engine CAN represent: it is applied on her OWN burstCast for 5s (S1-L1 'Camouflage for 5 sec') and REFRESHED on every full charge she lands DURING Full Burst (fullCharge + fbGate:'inFb', 5s — S1-L2), so it stays live across her in-FB burst cannon volley (each cannon shot is an in-FB full charge that refreshes it). This is the co-extensive-window construction (the selfStatus/requiresSelfStatus channel exists as of 2026-08-24 and could replace it mechanically; the shipped windows are behavior-equivalent) — the nearest-wrong model is a permanent frame-0 passive ('continuously' misread as whole-fight), which the unit test discriminates against (multiple windowed applications with finite expiry, re-applied per in-FB full charge, NOT once per Full Burst). trueDamagePct pays off ONLY on true-flavored hits, and her sustained base SR normals are NOT true-flavored (the unmodeled flavor change above), so the buff is inert on them and pays off solely on her true-flavored burst cannon shots (~6 per burst). There is therefore no always-on over-credit; the residual error is an UNDER-count — the kit intends the camouflage-uptime fraction of her base SR DPS to also be true-flavored and amplified (the ⚑ below). BURST 'Explosive Round' (ChangeWeapon): weaponSwap to a 1-round true-damage cannon — damagePct 105.6 ('105.6% of final ATK as true damage'), chargeMultPct 300 ('Full Charge damage: 300% of damage' = ×3 on the 105.6, i.e. ~316.8% ATK per full charge — a multiplier on the swap's own damage, NOT +300 additive charge% and NOT 300% of ATK), chargeTimeSec 0.3 ('Charge time: 0.3 sec'), maxAmmo 1 ('Max Ammunition Capacity: 1 round'), trueNormals:true (the shots are true-flavored, so the trueDamagePct buffs pay off on them). The cannon is a REAL weapon change — no sameWeapon marker — so it takes the magazine refill at both ends: she enters the window on the cannon's 1-round magazine (not on however many SR rounds she happened to be carrying, which used to let her fire a whole SR magazine's worth of cannon shots before the first reload — worth -21% on her total) and her base SR is handed back full on exit. The kit states NEITHER a swap duration NOR 'deactivates when all rounds fired' (unlike e-h, whose kit says the latter and so uses maxShots:1) — so the 1-round magazine CYCLES over the swap window (fire / reload 141f / fire …), firing ~6 cannon shots per burst at ~0.3s charge + ~2.35s reload each. durationSec:10 is the Full-Burst-window convention (e-h / red-hood precedent) and is ⚑ kit-silent (see caveats). 'Explosive Round: Damage Taken ▲27.87% for 10s' is an ON-HIT rider of the cannon shots ('Target: Target(s) hit') — boss damageTakenPct 27.87 / 10s on fullCharge gated swapGate:'swapped', so it applies on the first cannon shot's landing and REFRESHES per subsequent cannon shot (~96% team uptime across the fight, vs ~67% for a cast-once encoding). The 'Fires an Exploding Bullet dealing area-of-effect damage' splash radius is inert vs the single partless boss (unmodeled). Cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5, S5/S6 claude-opus-5, S7 kimi-code/k3. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-27.

caveats: ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED (tier 2): S1-L3 'Normal attacks deal true damage continuously' — the FLAVOR CHANGE of her sustained SR normals to true damage is UNMODELED. The engine's only true-normal mechanism is weaponSwap.trueNormals, which is (a) windowed (needs a durationSec) and (b) cannot coexist with her burst cannon swap (the engine holds a single swap slot — a fight-length trueNormals swap would be clobbered by the cannon swap on every burst and never restore). The Camouflage gate could now be a named status (the selfStatus/requiresSelfStatus channel exists as of 2026-08-24), but the binding constraint is the single swap slot. Estimate: as shipped, her sustained SR normals stay NON-true, so the self trueDamagePct 42.24 buff is near-inert outside the burst cannon shot (it pays off fully on the cannon, which IS true-flavored); the kit intends ~camouflage-uptime fraction of her main SR DPS to be true-flavored and amplified. Camouflage uptime is partial (5s per 20s burst + Full-Charge-during-Full-Burst refreshes, roughly half the fight). Recipe: a permanent trueNormals flag that survives weapon-swap coexistence + a camouflage-uptime model (or a targetStatus-proxied camouflage window driving a windowed trueNormals swap), then popup-read the true-damage popup count / camouflage uptime in an eunhwa-tu recording. The trueDamagePct 42.24 buff itself is encoded and exact for the cannon payoff.

⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED (tier 2): the burst cannon swap DURATION is kit-silent — the kit gives 'Max Ammunition Capacity: 1 round' but states neither a 'for N sec' window nor 'deactivates when all rounds fired'. Estimate: durationSec 10 (the Full-Burst-window convention shared with e-h / red-hood); the 1-round magazine cycles over that window (fire / 141f reload / fire …) for ~6 true-damage cannon shots per burst. A shorter real window fires fewer shots (damage is roughly linear in shot count: 10s ≈ 6 shots ≈ double the single-shot reading). Recipe: an eunhwa-tu recording — count cannon popups per burst and the frame her base SR fire resumes; rescale durationSec to match.

burst: 'Damage Taken ▲27.87% for 10s' is an ON-HIT rider of the cannon shots (fullCharge + swapGate:'swapped'), so it lands on the first cannon shot (~0.3s after cast) and refreshes per subsequent shot — ~96% team uptime across the fight. The first cannon shot of each burst does NOT benefit (the debuff applies AFTER that shot's damage resolves, the per-pull trigger convention), faithful to 'target(s) hit'.

burst: on swap exit (durationSec expiry) the engine forces an empty-belt reload before SR fire resumes — the shared weaponSwap exit convention (e-h / snow-white-heavy-arms), not an ETU-specific choice; the in-game weapon-restore timing at swap deactivation is unmeasured.

skill2: the S2 bonus 'when applying LT Formation to self' is gated on emma-tactical-upgrade presence via teamHas.slugs (auto, presence ≡ formation applied). emma-tu's MIRROR bonus ('when applying AS Formation to self') is behind a manual mode on emma-tu (default OFF) — an asymmetry in the landed encodings: ETU's bonus auto-fires with emma-tu present, emma-tu's requires selecting its AS mode. Reconcile to a single auto-gate convention if both sisters grade a team together.
